summary:
Iteration 4: All 4 NEW features verified end-to-end (backend pytest 6/6 PASS + mobile web UI 4/4 flows OK). Threaded comments: POST with parent_id creates a reply; GET returns comments sorted ascending with parent_id field on all iter4-created docs. Coup-de-cœur enrichment: GET /api/recipes, /api/recipes/{id}, /api/recipes/mine, /api/recipes/favorites all return like_count (int) + coup_de_coeur (bool); liking a recipe promotes it to coup_de_coeur=true in the global top-5. UI verified on mobile 390x844: (1) Recipe detail Communauté tab—posted a comment, tapped reply-btn-{id}, reply-banner ('Réponse à Chef Test') appeared, sent a reply via comment-send, reply rendered indented under the parent. (2) Baguette Tradition Préparation tab shows start-all-timers with 'Lancer les 6 minuteurs en séquence'; tapping starts timer-bar showing 'Étape 1 · 1/6' with real countdown; timer-skip advances to 'Étape 2 · 2/6'; timer-stop dismisses the bar. (3) Calculator → save-as-recipe navigates to /share with input-ingredients prefilled ('1000 g de farine
650 g d'eau (hydratation 65%)
20 g de sel
10 g de levure'), input-title, input-hydration and input-description prefilled; publish-btn creates the recipe and it appears in Profile > Mes recettes. (4) Home 'Coups de cœur' section visible with award badge (cardBadge) overlay on the cdc-* card; Recettes tab card shows the award badge on coup_de_coeur recipe (TEST_UI_Recette3); recipe detail hero shows cdc-badge on TEST_UI_Recette3 and correctly absent on Baguette Tradition (0 likes). No React Native deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues detected. Console still shows RN Web 'shadow*' deprecation warning (cosmetic).

issues: RN Web still logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — non-blocking cosmetic warning already flagged in iter3.

action_items: OPTIONAL / low priority: replace remaining shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warning.

OPTIONAL: legacy comments (created before iter4) don't carry the parent_id field. Consider a one-shot migration setting parent_id=null on old docs so the GET response schema is uniform. Frontend already treats missing parent_id as top-level so it is not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.enrich_recipes uses two efficient aggregation queries (like_counts + global_top_liked) and is applied uniformly across list/get/mine/favorites — correct and DRY.
COUP_DE_COEUR_TOP_N=5 with c>0 guard correctly excludes zero-like recipes from the badge.
comments GET now sorts ascending (created_at, 1) — matches iter4 spec.

TimerContext.startSequence + auto-advance effect correctly advances after a step reaches 0 (1.5s buffer) and skip() immediately promotes the next queue item; currentIndex increments monotonically providing the '1/6', '2/6' progress label.
calculator.tsx correctly builds prefill query and navigates to /share; share.tsx must be reading prefill* params (verified by UI — title/ingredients/hydration/description all populated on arrival).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of new-feature flows (threaded reply, multi-step timer sequence + skip + stop, calculator save-as-recipe + publish, coup-de-cœur badges on home/list/detail)

Backend tests + UI created: 3 new comments on the first seeded recipe (top+reply from pytest, plus 'TEST_iter4_ui top …' + 'TEST_iter4_ui reply …' from UI), 1 like preserved on TEST_UI_Recette3 (keeps coup_de_coeur=true), and 1 new user recipe 'TEST_iter4_calc_<epoch>' visible in Profile > Mes recettes.

Recipe with existing coup_de_coeur = TEST_UI_Recette3 (1 like). External URL https://baker-recipes-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
